method: Static candidate inventory, not semantic deduplication or runtime proof. Counts include Java SQL string literals; exclusions target/node_modules/dist/__tests__/src/test; error extraction covers direct constructors and named helper calls only.
limitations: Static candidates only, not proof of semantic duplication
Natural-language exception candidates include internal diagnostics; do not expose or mechanically translate all
No runtime behavior, database or process changes; no tests/build/model calls
phase: Pre-implementation historical snapshot; current implementation is documented in docs/decisions/domain-status-and-backend-i18n.md
